The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) has introduced mandatory certificate of conformity (CoC) requirements for poultry and poultry products exported from Brazil to Saudi Arabia. Effective April 1, 2026, shipments from SFDA-approved establishments must be accompanied by a valid CoC. What exporters need to know now 
The new requirement forms part of the SFDA's food conformity assessment framework and introduces an additional compliance step for Brazilian poultry exporters and other stakeholders involved in the supply chain.
